name: madrasah-attendance-bridge
description: Standalone Node.js service that speaks a fingerprint device's push protocol and forwards each punch to POST /api/device/punch on the main madrasah-website server. See README.md — this is NOT part of the main app's npm install/build/check (docs/ATTENDANCE_DEVICE_PLAN.md, Phase 5: bridge lives outside the main codebase on purpose).
